about: A1: Hands Of Fate final step is a talk to the peaceful Shade, not a level-54 kill

entries.why: step 2 was a KillFinish of the level-54 Shade at a MinLevel-30 quest; walkthrough 184 (Hands Of Fate): you hand the shade the scroll and tome, Morgana appears and kills him - the player talks to him, never fights him
the extra level-54 hostile event spawn is not needed: the standing Shade (CapnBry sighting zone 19 18864,23551) is made peaceful and is the talk target
